options.name: api_path
options.description: Base NITRO API path. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: bundle
options.description: Parse the certificate chain as a single file after linking the server certificate to its issuer's certificate within the file.

options.name: cert
options.description: Name of and, optionally, path to the X509 certificate file that is used to form the certificate-key pair. The certificate file should be present on the appliance's hard-disk drive or solid-state drive. Storing a certificate in any location other than the default might cause inconsistency in a high availability setup. /nsconfig/ssl/ is the default path.

options.name: certkey
options.description: Name for the certificate and private-key pair. Must begin with an ASCII alphanumeric or underscore (_) character, and must contain only ASCII alphanumeric, underscore, hash (#), period (.), space, colon (:), at (@), equals (=), and hyphen (-) characters. Cannot be changed after the certificate-key pair is created.  The following requirement applies only to the Citrix ADC CLI: If the name includes one or more spaces, enclose the name in double or single quotation marks (for example, "my cert" or

options.name: deletecertkeyfilesonremoval
options.description: This option is used to automatically delete certificate/key files from physical device when the added certkey is removed. When deleteCertKeyFilesOnRemoval option is used at rm certkey command, it overwrites the deleteCertKeyFilesOnRemoval setting used at add/set certkey command

options.name: deletefromdevice
options.description: Delete cert/key file from file system.

options.name: expirymonitor
options.description: Issue an alert when the certificate is about to expire.

options.name: fipskey
options.description: Name of the FIPS key that was created inside the Hardware Security Module (HSM) of a FIPS appliance, or a key that was imported into the HSM.

options.name: hsmkey
options.description: Name of the HSM key that was created in the External Hardware Security Module (HSM) of a FIPS appliance.

options.name: inform
options.description: Input format of the certificate and the private-key files. The three formats supported by the appliance are: C(PEM) - Privacy Enhanced Mail C(DER) - Distinguished Encoding Rule C(PFX) - Personal Information Exchange

options.name: key
options.description: Name of and, optionally, path to the private-key file that is used to form the certificate-key pair. The certificate file should be present on the appliance's hard-disk drive or solid-state drive. Storing a certificate in any location other than the default might cause inconsistency in a high availability setup. /nsconfig/ssl/ is the default path.

options.name: linkcertkeyname
options.description: Name of the Certificate Authority certificate-key pair to which to link a certificate-key pair.

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_id
options.description: The ID of the managed NetScaler instance to which NetScaler Console has to configure as a proxy server. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_ip
options.description: The IP of the managed NetScaler instance to which NetScaler Console has to configure as a proxy server. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_name
options.description: The name of the managed NetScaler instance to which NetScaler Console has to configure as a proxy server. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_password
options.description: The password of the managed NetScaler instance. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call In Settings > Administration > System Configurations > Basic Settings, if you select Prompt Credentials for Instance Login, ensure to configure username and password of a managed instance.

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_username
options.description: The username of the managed NetScaler instance. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call In Settings > Administration > System Configurations > Basic Settings, if you select Prompt Credentials for Instance Login, ensure to configure username and password of a managed instance.

options.name: netscaler_console_as_proxy_server
options.description: The IP address of the NetScaler ADC appliance acting as a proxy server. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: nitro_auth_token
options.description: The authentication token provided by a login operation.

options.name: nitro_pass
options.description: The password with which to authenticate to the NetScaler ADC node.

options.name: nitro_protocol
options.description: Which protocol to use when accessing the nitro API objects.

options.name: nitro_user
options.description: The username with which to authenticate to the NetScaler ADC node.

options.name: nodomaincheck
options.description: Override the check for matching domain names during a certificate update operation.

options.name: notificationperiod
options.description: Time, in number of days, before certificate expiration, at which to generate an alert that the certificate is about to expire.

options.name: nsip
options.description: The ip address of the NetScaler ADC appliance where the nitro API calls will be made. The port can be specified with the colon (:). E.g. 192.168.1.1:555.

options.name: ocspstaplingcache
options.description: Clear cached ocspStapling response in certkey.

options.name: passplain
options.description: Pass phrase used to encrypt the private-key. Required when adding an encrypted private-key in PEM format.

options.name: password
options.description: Passphrase that was used to encrypt the private-key. Use this option to load encrypted private-keys in PEM format.

options.name: remove_non_updatable_params
options.description: When given yes, the module will remove any parameters that are not updatable in the resource. If no, the module will return error if any non-updatable parameters are provided.

options.name: save_config
options.description: If C(true) the module will save the configuration on the NetScaler ADC node if it makes any changes. The module will not save the configuration on the NetScaler ADC node if it made no changes.

options.name: sslcertkey_sslocspresponder_binding
options.description: Bindings for sslcertkey_sslocspresponder_binding resource

options.name: state
options.description: The state of the resource being configured by the module on the NetScaler ADC node. When C(present), the resource will be added/updated configured according to the module's parameters. When C(absent), the resource will be deleted from the NetScaler ADC node. When C(unset), the resource will be unset on the NetScaler ADC node. When C(changed), the resource will be changed(?action=update) on the NetScaler ADC node.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If C(false), SSL certificates will not be validated. This should only be used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates.
